notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an options button to the main interface
[*]Options interface allows modification of window mode
[*]Game speed settings will be saved
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Issue where shop affixes and derivative cards overlap each other
[*]Bloodstone's attack power displays as 0, but it can still deal damage
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Minor bug fixed
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
[*] - When the game is launched for the first time, it will detect the system language and switch automatically. (Special thanks to player nvkhoa @Discord)
[/list]


Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] - Fixed an issue where derivative cards were not displayed correctly 
[*] - Fixed an issue where right-clicking the mouse would also select rewards
[*] - Corrected typos on several cards
[*] - Fixed an issue where the icon in the relic detail's affix box was not displayed correctly
[*] - Fixed an issue where some slash skills did not work correctly when there was a "Phantom Dagger" in a row of enemies
[*] - Fixed an issue where "Thunder Echo" showed no changes after upgrading
[*] - Adjusted the duration of some sound effects
[*] - Fixed screen anomalies caused by having too many cards in hand
[/list]
